title: Bitvavo introduces Flex and Fixed Staking structure
description: Bitvavo announced a redefined staking structure with Flex Staking for liquid reward earning and Fixed Staking for higher returns in exchange for a defined asset lock-up period.
notes: This establishes the current Flex/Fixed staking structure but is not treated as the original launch date of the broader Bitvavo Earn umbrella.

title: Coinmetro launches BTC Earn
description: Coinmetro launched BTC Earn with 3, 6, 12 and 24 month BTC commitment terms, real-time BTC rewards and an internally managed reward structure that the company says does not rely on external lending platforms or third-party protocols.
notes: The return of committed BTC at term end is a first-party product promise, not a CYA principal or solvency guarantee.
